description: This file defines the AjaxPageState class which handles expanding compressed ajax_page_state query parameters into an array, merging library data, and setting request attributes within Drupal's HTTP kernel middleware.

classes.name: AjaxPageState
classes.description: Handles expanding and merging ajax_page_state query parameters in Drupal's HTTP kernel middleware.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes AjaxPageState with a wrapped HTTP kernel.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the request to expand ajax_page_state parameters, merge libraries, and set request attributes.

methods.name: parseAjaxPageState
methods.description: Decompresses the 'libraries' parameter in ajax_page_state array.
